explanation: externalReferenceFormat.ts adds the visium provider and root, TRACKED_SOURCE_PROVIDERS (providers built from a tracked extract) and an optional derivedFrom on validation checkpoints; sourceJson.ts allow-lists the visium family. missingLabel reads a source absentLabel so an off-panel gene reads Not measured in this Visium probe panel. CSV exports gain a source_credit column (provider attribution and licence, else the citation). The Sources & validation note names the Visium recomputation check. The reader and manifest validation are unchanged.
